# Nect shell completion scripts
# Source this file in your shell profile:
#   bash: source <(nect completions bash)
#   zsh:  source <(nect completions zsh)
#   fish: source <(nect completions fish)

# The completions are generated by `nect completions <shell>` command
# This file documents the approach; actual generation is in src/cli/completions.rs

# Supported shells: bash, zsh, fish, elvish, powershell

# Commands and their arguments:
# run [--interp] [--stack-trace] <file> [args...]
# check <file>
# disasm <file>
# build <file> [-o <path>] [--cc <compiler>] [--target <triple>] [--sysroot <path>] [--emit-c] [--keep-c]
# pkg [init|add|remove|install|update|build|publish|run|list|outdated|tree|audit|search]
# test [--filter <name>]
# bench [name]
# fmt [--check] [--indent <n>] [--trailing-comma] [--single-quote] [--brace-style <style>] [file]
# lint [--no-unused] [--no-shadowing] [--no-dead-code] [--no-unused-params] [file]
# debug [file]
# doctor
# new <name>
# clean
# mem-profile <file>
# --version
# --help
